subject: Recruiting stack contract renegotiation: Greenhouse + Checkr + LMS options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@greenhouse.io>, Evan Cho <evan@checkr.com>, partner-ops@lessonly.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recruiting stack renewal window + alignment on pricing/terms

Hi Samira / Evan / Lessonly team —

We’re coming up on the renewal window for our core hiring stack (ATS + background checks) and looking to evaluate options for the next 12–24 months. I’d like to align on three things this week:

1) Best commercial offer you can provide for our current seat/volume profile (see attached usage snapshot).
2) Any incentives for multi-product commitments or extended term (24 months).
3) Timeline for a revised SOW / DocuSign-ready contract so we can coordinate procurement and finance sign-off.

Context: Greenhouse has been our ATS since 2022; Checkr handles global background checks; we’re exploring a learning platform refresh (Lessonly demo scheduled next week). We need predictable unit economics and clearer audit logs/retention for compliance.

Laura / Monica / Vivek — I’ve looped you in for pricing guidance and any technical questions on integrations. Marcus, flagging for budgetary approval (we may ask for a one-time credit).

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Talent Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: recruiting_usage_snapshot_Q3_2026.csv (referenced)

From: Samira Khan <samira@greenhouse.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recruiting stack renewal window + alignment on pricing/terms

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the heads up and the usage details. I’m attaching a formal renewal proposal with two options: 12-month standard renewal and 24-month committed pricing with a 12% credit and waived onboarding fee for any new modules (e.g., Interviewing, Scorecards). I can also hold the pricing for 14 days while you run internal approvals.

Key notes:
- Audit logs retention to 7 years is available as an add-on (we included pricing).
- API request volume over 3M calls/month will require the enterprise throughput tier (we show current usage is just under that).

If it helps, we can do a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to walk the SOW and DocuSign steps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Strategic Accounts, Greenhouse

Attachments: Greenhouse_Renewal_Proposal_2026.pdf

From: Evan Cho <evan@checkr.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@vendorops.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recruiting stack renewal window + alignment on pricing/terms

Evelyn / Laura —

Appreciate the ping. Attached is a draft SOW that aligns with your current international volume and the premium identity verification package we discussed in June. For commercial flexibility we can offer a volume-tiered rebate starting at 5% for committed spend > $150k/yr, and up to 10% for multi-year contracts. The SOW includes a 30-day SLAs appendix and updated data-retention language for EU hires.

We’ll need your legal team to confirm the standard IP/data handling clauses; procurement@vendorops can coordinate a redline review.

Regards,
Evan Cho
Director, Enterprise Sales — Checkr

Attachments: Checkr_SOW_Draft_20261102.docx

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: samira@greenhouse.io, evan@checkr.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recruiting stack renewal window + alignment on pricing/terms

Team —

Thanks for the proposals. A few internal asks before we push forward:

- Can Greenhouse scope a 24-month committed option with a 10% credit and explicit uplift cap for API usage? We want cost predictability.
- Checkr: please confirm whether identity fraud checks are included in the quoted premium package or are an additional line item; we need that spelled out for payroll/security.
- For the LMS: Marcus, can you confirm if we need full SCORM support or just course-hosting + reporting? That’ll materially change vendor selection.

Procurement note: I’ve raised PROC-412 so Procurement can expedite the DocuSign workflow once commercial terms are finalized.

Quick answers: Marcus — we’re projecting 320 hires in 2027 and prefer a 24-month term if the delta to 12-month is under 15%. Vivek — can you advise on retention policy requirements for compliance, especially EMEA?

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP People Operations
Redwood Inference

>

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: samira@greenhouse.io, evan@checkr.com, procurement@vendorops.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recruiting stack renewal window + alignment on pricing/terms

Laura / team —

SCORM support: we don’t require full LMS playback or SCORM sequencing for the current program; we need course hosting, progress reporting, and SSO + SCIM for user provisioning. That narrows the LMS to lighter vendors (Lessonly type) and removes enterprise LMS pricing line items.

Decision / next steps I approve:
1) Move Greenhouse to a 24-month committed agreement conditional on a 10% credit and an API usage cap clause; ask Samira to include a 14-day hold.
2) Ask Checkr to confirm identity fraud inclusion and provide the 5% rebate at $150k/yr threshold; procurement to review redlines.
3) Continue LMS procurement with Lessonly; request a single-year contract with opt-out at renewal if integrations hit unforeseen costs.

Procurement, please prepare the DocuSign packets for Greenhouse + Checkr once we have the final SOWs. Evelyn — can you coordinate the final commercial calls tomorrow AM?

Marcus Lin
VP Finance Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference
